earnings.title: Investor Relations
highlights: Axon reports record Q3 2026 revenue of $909 million, up 28% year over year
Net income of $57 million increases from a net loss in the prior-year period; Adjusted EBITDA of $236 million increases 33% year over year
Software & Services revenue growth accelerates to 43% year over year, reaches $437 million
Platform Solutions revenue grows 106% year over year to $125 million
AI bookings up over 50% year to date; AI ARR surpasses $100 million
outlook: The reduction from our prior expectations is concentrated in three large Federal Dedrone deployments representing approximately $130 million of revenue we no longer expect in 2026.

Platform Solutions led Connected Devices growth, increasing 106% to $125 million, and underlying performance would have been even stronger absent the delayed timing of an approximately $30 million Federal Dedrone deployment we had expected to recognize during the quarter.
We expect fourth-quarter revenue in a range of $990 million to $1.01 billion and Adjusted EBITDA of $245 million to $250 million.
Scale that already exists: Skydio expects about $1 billion of bookings this fiscal year.

items.heading: We substantially depend on sales of our CEDs, and if these products do not continue to be widely accepted, our growth prospects, operating results and financial condition will be diminished.
If we are unable to design, introduce, sell and deploy new products or new product features successfully, our business and financial results could be adversely affected.
We face risks associated with rapid technological change and new competing products.
Negative publicity could adversely impact sales, which could cause our revenues or operating results to decline.
Acquisitions of, or investments in, other products, technologies or businesses could disrupt our business, dilute shareholder value, or adversely affect our operating results.
We may not successfully manage our growth or plan for future growth.
